This is a senior-level systems engineering role on Cloudflare's Application Security team, which builds the WAF, Page Shield, Web Asset Management, and API Shield products. The work involves designing and operating distributed services at very large scale, around 100 million requests per second, including on-call rotation and reviewing RFCs and code. The core stack is Go or Rust on Linux, with devops tooling such as Kubernetes, Salt, Kafka, and systemd.
